family.title: FIELD STATION: MAGPIE — Interference Field Instrument
family.summary: A persistent sonic-visual instrument in which rotating vector families form temporary consensus, rhythms, and recognizable structures without explicitly drawing resolved objects.

provenance.source_notes: Approved direction: low-resolution spinning vectors remain the sole resolved visual language. Multiple rotational frequencies create temporary consensus, rhythm, implied geometry, anticipation, locking, dissolution, memory, and release. The work should never switch to a separate high-resolution hero object. FIELD STATION: MAGPIE remains fixed in amber phosphor as station identity. The approved MP4, preview, and state snapshot are retained locally pending a binary-capable repository upload.
